title: Document Processing and Dataset Quality
description: Follow a document from collection through extraction, preparation and validation.

guide.title: Collect the source
guide.text: Start with paper and book collection if versions or acquisition history are getting lost. Keep the original file and why you saved it before converting anything.

guide.title: Extract and prepare
guide.text: Read PDF extraction when layout or reading order matters. Continue to dataset preparation for identifiers, conflicting rows and split rules. Saved chat and contact extraction cover records that must keep a precise source reference.

guide.title: Validate the output
guide.text: Use the synthetic data article when you can check answers independently. Image conversion covers dimensions, byte limits and metadata. Note organisation explains how to make a reading copy while keeping the originals.

title: Retrieval, Embeddings and Evidence Tracking
description: Check representations, source versions and what a retrieved result actually supports.

guide.title: Check the representation
guide.text: Start with embedding compatibility before changing your search model. Equal vector dimensions do not mean the query and document vectors share a coordinate system.

guide.title: Keep the index current
guide.text: CloudVec explains how database changes reach a vector index after a crash. Graph memory asks whether explicit relationships improve on ordinary metadata retrieval. Assistant memory adds ownership and time validity.

guide.title: Keep evidence attached
guide.text: For retrieval augmented generation, retain the passage and version behind each answer. Autoresearch, Xanadu and OpenAbstract cover citation history, stable passage links and corrections. SL5 adds nested discussion attribution.

title: AI Agent Systems: Memory and Evaluation
description: Follow state, attribution and evaluation through small agent systems.

guide.title: Start with state and failures
guide.text: BotSim introduces a small local community. The orchestration article follows streamed events, failures and cancellation. Both distinguish deterministic test providers from live language models.

guide.title: Test coordination
guide.text: The swarm experiment measures neighbour coupling in a tiny grammar. Mixture of Perspectives separates hard constraints from preference disagreements. Neither fixture establishes general intelligence or better decisions in the world.

guide.title: Evaluate revision and training
guide.text: Read self correction before adding repeated answer revisions, then self rewarding training for preference loss and independent evaluation. The Minecraft article is a personal game building account, not a model benchmark.

title: LLM Interpretability and Evaluation
description: Move from a model view to compatible captures, interventions and bounded comparisons.

guide.title: Read the map first
guide.text: Start with the model map article to separate architecture, observed activations and causal evidence. Activation mapping then explains token occurrence identity and compatible projections.

guide.title: Check what a result establishes
guide.text: Arithmetic across notations requires baseline competence before circuit analysis. Sparse feature recovery separates reconstruction from recovery of known generating features. Glow Worm measures byte prediction rather than chatbot quality.

guide.title: Related evaluation lessons from security
guide.text: The signal and protocol studies use different tasks, but make useful comparisons about distribution shift, false alarms and resource budgets. The security catalogue is a separate map of defensive proposals.

title: Neural Architecture Experiments
description: Separate implemented mechanisms, small pilot findings and untested architecture proposals.

guide.title: Choose one mechanism
guide.text: The architecture overview separates memory, routing, repair and representation ideas. Start with a mechanism whose result you can check against a simple control.

guide.title: Compare controls and costs
guide.text: Read temporal attention and causal memory for sequence history, judge heads and face based attention for gating, and Hydraform for mutation. Token repair needs a strong rule baseline. BitNet and SVD separate storage savings from execution speed and functional error.

guide.title: Data structures are a separate branch
guide.text: The 4D lattice and adaptive range summary articles concern query algorithms. Compare construction and query costs with scanning before connecting those results to neural architecture claims.
